low.title: Full-Day Prague History Walk on a Budget
low.summary: Explore Prague’s historic core, bridges, and royal landmarks with minimal cost while soaking in centuries of culture.

schedule.title: Old Town Square
schedule.description: Start your morning surrounded by Gothic and Baroque architecture — see the Astronomical Clock and Church of Our Lady before Týn.

schedule.title: Charles Bridge Walk
schedule.description: Cross the 14th-century bridge lined with 30 statues — one of Prague’s most iconic sights.

schedule.title: Budget Lunch Stop
schedule.description: Enjoy a simple Czech meal — goulash or soup at a local bistro near Malá Strana.

schedule.title: Lesser Town Walk
schedule.description: Explore Baroque palaces, cobbled streets, and hidden courtyards of Malá Strana.

schedule.title: Prague Castle Exterior
schedule.description: Climb up to the castle complex for panoramic views — free access to courtyards and gardens.

schedule.title: Golden Hour Castle Views
schedule.description: Watch the sunset over the Vltava and old town rooftops.

medium.title: Balanced Historical Prague Day
medium.summary: Combine Prague’s iconic historical sites with comfortable museum visits and classic Czech meals.

schedule.title: Prague Castle Complex
schedule.description: Visit St. Vitus Cathedral, Old Royal Palace, and Golden Lane for a deeper look at Czech royalty.

schedule.title: Lunch at U Zlaté Studně
schedule.description: Traditional Czech cuisine in a restaurant with castle views.

schedule.title: Jewish Quarter (Josefov)
schedule.description: Walk through historic synagogues and the Old Jewish Cemetery.

schedule.title: Old Town Evening Walk
schedule.description: Enjoy Prague’s history under the evening lights — ideal for photos.

high.title: High-End Historical Exploration
high.summary: A deeper dive into Czech history through curated tours, top museums, and elegant restaurants.

schedule.title: Guided Tour of Prague Castle
schedule.description: Professional guide through the cathedral, royal chambers, and courtyards.

schedule.title: Lunch at Mlynec
schedule.description: Fine dining with views of Charles Bridge — modern Czech cuisine.

schedule.title: National Museum
schedule.description: Explore the main national collection of Czech history and culture.

schedule.title: Historic Café Stop – Café Louvre
schedule.description: End your day with dessert or coffee in a café that hosted Einstein and Kafka.

comfortable.title: Luxury Historical Prague Journey
comfortable.summary: An exclusive, private experience through Prague’s royal and cultural heritage with fine dining and personal guides.

schedule.title: Private Historical Tour
schedule.description: A personalized walk through the castle, cathedral, and hidden heritage spots.

schedule.title: Fine Dining Lunch at Bellevue
schedule.description: Elegant riverside restaurant with refined Czech cuisine.

schedule.title: Exclusive Museum Visit – Strahov Library
schedule.description: Private access to one of Europe’s most beautiful historic libraries.

schedule.title: Evening Castle Views & Champagne
schedule.description: Watch the illuminated skyline of Prague Castle from Letná Park viewpoint.
